framework_metadata.description: AMD Instinct (gfx950/gfx942), fully resident: 288 GB per MI355X holds the model on each rank; AITER attention, the cookbook's AMD backend policy.
framework_metadata.notes: Derived 2026-10-10 from docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx (sglang main 3831e7e09): its config builder applies `--attention-backend aiter` + SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 on mi300x/mi355x and keeps weights resident off the consumer tier; the topology is the datacenter Ulysses-2 command this case uses on B200. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured on this hardware. MINIMAX_H3_VAE_DECODER_FUSED_NORM=0 (2026-10-10, MI355X, sglang 3831e7e09): the VAE decoder's fused scale-add RMSNorm Triton kernels (#41906) use PTX inline asm (mul.rn.f32, constraint 'f') from sglang/kernels/numerics.py; on ROCm they fail to compile and decode to an all-NaN video. The flag keeps the eager norm path, which computes the same values.
framework_metadata.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --model-variant fl2va --ulysses-degree 2 --performance-mode speed --attention-backend aiter --enable-torch-compile false

framework_metadata.description: AMD ROCm: the recipe's ROCm four-GPU command (USP, text-encoder TP, VAE patch parallel tile, FLASH_ATTN -> AITER packed varlen) at two GPUs, resident.
framework_metadata.notes: Derived 2026-10-10: the recipe's 'ROCm four GPUs' command scaled to num_gpus=2 the way the CUDA profiles scale its four-GPU section; no CPU offload at 288 GB/GPU. The recipe notes text-encoder TP was validated on gfx942 only. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured on this hardware.

results.server_command: vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 --port 46001 --host 127.0.0.1 --omni --trust-remote-code --task-type fl2va --num-gpus 2 --usp 2 --ring 1 --text-encoder-tp-size 2 --vae-patch-parallel-size 2 --vae-parallel-mode tile --vae-use-tiling --diffusion-attention-backend FLASH_ATTN
